name: forum
description: Discussion forum backend: users and roles, threads and posts, editing windows, bans and moderation, mentions and notifications, HTML rendering.
author: test2 benchmark author (language model, written without reading the reviewer)

issues.description: The deferred jobs are lambdas that read the loop variable user when they run, after the loop ended, so every job notifies the last mentioned user.
issues.fix_hint: Bind the recipient when the job is created (default argument or functools.partial).

issues.description: timedelta.seconds is only the seconds part and ignores whole days, so a post becomes editable again by its author for 15 minutes every day.
issues.fix_hint: Compare the timedelta itself with EDIT_WINDOW, or use total_seconds().

issues.anchor: return self.until is not None and self.start <= now < self.until
issues.description: The docstring says a ban without an end date is permanent, but a ban with until=None is never active, so permanent bans do nothing.
issues.fix_hint: Return self.start <= now and (self.until is None or now < self.until).

issues.description: The user-chosen display name is put into the HTML without escaping, so a name containing markup or a script tag is injected into every page showing the user's posts.
issues.fix_hint: Escape the display name with html.escape.

issues.description: posts imports text to extract mentions and text imports posts for the Post type and EDIT_GRACE; the two modules depend on each other.
Five levels of nested loops and ifs; counting reporters per post could be done once up front with guard clauses.
lock_thread and pin_thread repeat the same permission checks and audit entry code line for line.

decoys.why_it_is_fine: The body was escaped before the substitution and the mention pattern only matches letters, digits and underscores, so the name put into the link cannot carry markup.
It iterates over a copy, so removing from the original list is safe.
